summary: Offen is an open-source web analytics tool designed to capture visitor data while giving users transparent access to the information stored about them. It operates as a self-hosted alternative to mainstream tracking services, focusing on privacy compliance and lightweight data collection. The system is built using Go and distributed via Docker for containerised environments.
goodFor: It suits operators who need to track basic website metrics while strictly complying with privacy regulations and granting visitors direct oversight of their data.
watchOut: The project shows signs of being at risk regarding ongoing maintenance, meaning you may encounter unpatched bugs or lack timely security updates.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based Go application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your metrics data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
